95: 	 * @param width			The width of the {@link BufferedImage} to build.
96: 	 * @param height		The height of the {@link BufferedImage} to build.
97: 	 * @param imageType		The image type of the {@link BufferedImage} to build.
98: 	 */
99: 	public BufferedImageBuilder(int width, int height, int imageType) {
100: 		size(width, height);
101: 		imageType(imageType);
102: 	}
103: 	
104: 	/**
105: 	 * Generates a new {@code BufferedImage}.
106: 	 * 
107: 	 * @return		Returns a newly created {@link BufferedImage} from the
108: 	 * 				parameters set in the {@link BufferedImageBuilder}.
109: 	 */
110: 	public BufferedImage build() {
111: 		return new BufferedImage(width, height, imageType);
112: 	}
113: 
114: 	/**
115: 	 * Sets the type of the image of the {@link BufferedImage}.
116: 	 * 
117: 	 * @param imageType		The image type to use.
118: 	 * 						If {@link BufferedImage#TYPE_CUSTOM} is used, it
119: 	 * 						be substituted by {@link BufferedImage#TYPE_INT_ARGB}.
120: 	 * @return				This {@link BufferedImageBuilder} instance.
121: 	 */
122: 	public BufferedImageBuilder imageType(int imageType) {
123: 		if (imageType == BufferedImage.TYPE_CUSTOM) {
124: 			imageType = DEFAULT_TYPE;
125: 		}
126: 
127: 		this.imageType = imageType;
128: 		return this;
129: 	}
130: 	
131: 	/**
132: 	 * Sets the size for the {@code BufferedImage}.
133: 	 * 
134: 	 * @param width			The width of the image to create.
135: 	 * @param height		The height of the image to create.
136: 	 * @return				This {@link BufferedImageBuilder} instance.
137: 	 */
138: 	public BufferedImageBuilder size(int width, int height) {
139: 		width(width);
140: 		height(height);
141: 		return this;
142: 	}
143: 	
144: 	/**
145: 	 * Sets the width for the {@link BufferedImage}.
146: 	 * 
147: 	 * @param width			The width of the image to create.
148: 	 * @return				This {@link BufferedImageBuilder} instance.
149: 	 */
150: 	public BufferedImageBuilder width(int width) {
151: 		if (width <= 0) {
152: 			throw new IllegalArgumentException(
153: 					"Width must be greater than 0."
154: 			);
155: 		}
156: 		
157: 		this.width = width;
158: 		return this;
159: 	}
160: 	
161: 	/**
162: 	 * Sets the height for the {@link BufferedImage}.
163: 	 * 
164: 	 * @param height		The height of the image to create.
165: 	 * @return				This {@link BufferedImageBuilder} instance.
166: 	 */
167: 	public BufferedImageBuilder height(int height) {
168: 		if (height <= 0) {
169: 			throw new IllegalArgumentException(
170: 					"Height must be greater than 0."
171: 			);
172: 		}
173: 
174: 		this.height = height;
175: 		return this;
176: 	}
177: }
